compiled_state.title: Create deliberate-violation test branch, open PR, verify CI enforcement blocks merge
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
- DD1: Deliberate-violation test PR opened on this repo; gh pr checks confirms relevant CI check failed; actual check output recorded as ticket comment

## Description

Create a temporary test branch from the current session branch, add a file containing a benign-but-detectable security violation, push to GitHub, open a PR targeting main, poll until the CI llm-review check completes, and verify it failed. Record evidence as a ticket comment.

### Violation file content

Create file `tests/scripts/test-ci-violation-733f.sh` with ONLY this content:

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# DELIBERATE CI ENFORCEMENT TEST — this branch will be deleted after verification
# This file intentionally contains fake/example credential patterns to trigger
# the CI llm-review security overlay. No real secrets are present.
# Remove with: git push origin --delete <branch-name>

# Fake API key patterns (not real credentials — for CI enforcement testing only):
FAKE_GITHUB_TOKEN="ghp_FAKETEST1234567890123456789012345678"
FAKE_AWS_KEY="AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE"
FAKE_SECRET="wJalrXUtnFEMI/K7MDENG/bPxRfiCYEXAMPLEKEY"
echo "CI enforcement test — these are fake credentials, not real secrets"
```

This file should reliably trigger the security overlay in the CI llm-review job.

### Steps

1. Create and push a test branch:
```bash
BRANCH_NAME="test/ci-enforcement-violation-733f-$(date +%s)"
git checkout -b "$BRANCH_NAME"
cat > tests/scripts/test-ci-violation-733f.sh << 'EOF'
... (violation content above) ...
EOF
chmod +x tests/scripts/test-ci-violation-733f.sh
git add tests/scripts/test-ci-violation-733f.sh
git commit -m "test: deliberate CI enforcement violation — DELETE AFTER VERIFICATION"
git push origin "$BRANCH_NAME"
```

2. Open PR against main:
```bash
PR_URL=$(gh pr create \
  --base main \
  --head "$BRANCH_NAME" \
  --title "test: CI enforcement validation — deliberate violation — DO NOT MERGE" \
  --body "This PR intentionally contains fake credential patterns to verify that CI-side enforcement (llm-review security overlay) catches violations after enforcement.strategy=ci. Will be closed without merging. Part of epic 1083-fb3d story 733f-938c." \
  --label "do-not-merge" 2>/dev/null || true)
PR_NUMBER=$(echo "$PR_URL" | grep -oE '[0-9]+$')
echo "PR opened: $PR_URL (number: $PR_NUMBER)"
```

3. Record branch and PR info in ticket comment:
```bash
.claude/scripts/dso ticket comment 733f-938c-e6d9-464d "VIOLATION_PR: branch=$BRANCH_NAME pr=$PR_NUMBER url=$PR_URL"
```

4. Poll gh pr checks until llm-review completes (max 15 minutes):
```bash
for i in $(seq 1 30); do
    sleep 30
    CHECK_OUTPUT=$(gh pr checks "$PR_NUMBER" --repo navapbc/digital-service-orchestra 2>&1 || true)
    echo "$CHECK_OUTPUT"
    # Check if llm-review has a terminal status (FAIL or PASS)
    if echo "$CHECK_OUTPUT" | grep -q "llm-review.*fail\|llm-review.*FAIL"; then
        echo "llm-review FAILED — CI enforcement confirmed"
        break
    fi
    if echo "$CHECK_OUTPUT" | grep -q "In Progress\|pending\|queued"; then
        echo "Checks still running (attempt $i)..."
        continue
    fi
    # All checks terminal
    break
done
```

5. Verify gh pr merge --auto is blocked:
```bash
AUTO_MERGE_OUTPUT=$(gh pr merge "$PR_NUMBER" --auto --squash 2>&1 || true)
echo "Auto-merge attempt: $AUTO_MERGE_OUTPUT"
```

6. Record evidence as ticket comment:
```bash
CHECKS_OUTPUT=$(gh pr checks "$PR_NUMBER" --repo navapbc/digital-service-orchestra 2>&1 || true)
.claude/scripts/dso ticket comment 733f-938c-e6d9-464d "VIOLATION_PR_CHECKS: pr=$PR_NUMBER output=$CHECKS_OUTPUT"
```

### False-negative handling
If llm-review passes (doesn't catch the violation):
1. Record the false-negative in a ticket comment: `VIOLATION_FALSE_NEGATIVE: llm-review passed when block expected`
2. Create a P0 bug ticket: `[llm-review]: CI security overlay false-negative — fake credential pattern not detected`
3. Do NOT close the PR yet — Task 2 still closes it per DD2
4. Proceed to Task 2 anyway

**IMPORTANT**: Do NOT merge the PR under any circumstances. The PR must remain unmerged for Task 2 to close it.

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh 2>&1 | tail -5 || true
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py 2>/dev/null || true
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py 2>/dev/null || true
- [ ] VIOLATION_PR comment recorded on ticket 733f-938c with branch and PR number
  Verify: .claude/scripts/dso ticket show 733f-938c-e6d9-464d | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); found=[c for c in d.get('comments',[]) if 'VIOLATION_PR:' in c.get('body','')]; exit(0 if found else 1)"
- [ ] VIOLATION_PR_CHECKS comment recorded on ticket 733f-938c with gh pr checks output
  Verify: .claude/scripts/dso ticket show 733f-938c-e6d9-464d | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); found=[c for c in d.get('comments',[]) if 'VIOLATION_PR_CHECKS:' in c.get('body','')]; exit(0 if found else 1)"

comments.body: VIOLATION_FINDING: llm-review status=skipping (not failed). Pre-existing Hook Tests and Script Tests failures on main (PR #46, run 25352800446) prevent llm-review from running. The llm-review job has needs:[test-hooks,test-scripts] dependency — when those fail, llm-review is skipped. This means CI enforcement via llm-review security overlay cannot be verified while pre-existing test failures persist on main.
